mapper.select: SELECT ipb.* FROM IP_BLOCKLIST ipb WHERE ipb.is_effective_active = 1 ORDER BY ipb.priority DESC, CASE WHEN ipb.rule_action = 'BLOCK' THEN 0 ELSE 1 END ASC, ipb.updated_at DESC, ipb.ip_blocklist_idx DESC

SELECT ub.block_idx, ub.source_history_block_idx, ub.block_request_id, ub.block_target_key, ub.user_idx, u.user_id, u.nickname, ub.block_type, ub.blocked_ip, ub.is_active, ub.snapshot_status, ub.reason, ub.rule_action, ub.control_mode, ub.rule_origin_type, ub.source_scope, ub.block_category, ub.risk_score, ub.is_auto_block, ub.auto_block_source, ub.detail_message, ub.priority, ub.is_effective_active, ub.effective_status, ub.effective_status_reason, ub.effective_synced_at, ub.last_control_action, ub.last_control_by_user_idx, ub.last_control_at, ub.last_control_reason, ub.source_assessment_idx, ub.source_action_type, ub.source_action_group_id, ub.source_user_idx, ub.source_ip_address, ub.blocked_by_user_idx, ub.blocked_at, ub.released_by_user_idx, ub.released_at, ub.expires_at, ub.updated_at, ub.synced_at FROM USER_BLOCKLIST ub LEFT JOIN USERS u ON u.user_idx = ub.user_idx WHERE ub.is_active = 1 AND COALESCE(ub.snapshot_status, 'ACTIVE') = 'ACTIVE' AND COALESCE(ub.is_effective_active, 1) = 1 AND (ub.expires_at IS NULL OR ub.expires_at > NOW()) ORDER BY COALESCE(ub.priority, 1) DESC, ub.blocked_at DESC, ub.block_idx DESC
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO IP_BLOCKLIST ( ip_address, block_target_key, rule_action, control_mode, rule_origin_type, blocked_at, reason, match_type, source_scope, block_category, is_active, is_effective_active, effective_status, effective_status_reason, effective_synced_at, effective_synced_by_source, last_control_action, last_control_at, last_control_reason, priority, last_synced_at, updated_at ) VALUES ( #{ipAddress}, CONCAT('IP:', #{ipAddress}), 'BLOCK', 'MANUAL', 'MANUAL', NOW(), #{reason}, 'SINGLE_IP', 'GLOBAL', 'SPAM', TRUE, TRUE, 'EFFECTIVE', '현재 평가 대상입니다.', NOW(), 'SYSTEM', 'CREATE', NOW(), #{reason}, 1, NOW(), NOW() )

INSERT INTO IP_BLOCKLIST ( ip_address, block_target_key, rule_action, control_mode, rule_origin_type, blocked_at, reason, match_type, source_scope, block_category, is_active, is_effective_active, effective_status, effective_status_reason, effective_synced_at, effective_synced_by_source, last_control_action, last_control_at, last_control_reason, priority, last_synced_at, updated_at ) VALUES
(#{ip}, CONCAT('IP:', #{ip}), 'BLOCK', 'MANUAL', 'MANUAL', NOW(), #{reason}, 'SINGLE_IP', 'GLOBAL', 'SPAM', TRUE, TRUE, 'EFFECTIVE', '현재 평가 대상입니다.', NOW(), 'SYSTEM', 'CREATE', NOW(), #{reason}, 1, NOW(), NOW())

INSERT INTO IP_BLOCKLIST ( ip_address, block_target_key, block_request_id, rule_action, control_mode, rule_origin_type, source_history_block_idx, source_blocklist_idx, match_type, source_scope, block_category, user_idx, block_type, blocked_by_user_idx, source_action_type, source_action_group_id, source_user_idx, source_ip_address, blocked_at, reason, is_active, is_effective_active, effective_status, effective_status_reason, effective_synced_at, effective_synced_by_source, expires_at, released_at, released_by_user_idx, last_control_action, last_control_by_user_idx, last_control_at, last_control_reason, priority, last_synced_at, updated_at ) VALUES ( #{ipAddress}, #{blockTargetKey}, #{blockRequestId}, 'BLOCK', 'MANUAL', 'MANUAL', #{sourceHistoryBlockIdx}, #{sourceBlocklistIdx}, 'SINGLE_IP', 'USER_ACTION', 'MANUAL', #{userIdx}, #{blockType}, #{blockedByUserIdx}, #{sourceActionType}, #{sourceActionGroupId}, #{sourceUserIdx}, #{sourceIpAddress}, NOW(), #{reason}, TRUE, TRUE, 'EFFECTIVE', '현재 평가 대상입니다.', NOW(), 'SYSTEM', #{expiresAt}, NULL, NULL, 'CREATE', #{blockedByUserIdx}, NOW(), #{reason}, 1, NOW(), NOW() )
mapper.select: SELECT NULL AS ip_blocklist_idx, h.block_idx AS source_history_block_idx, NULL AS source_blocklist_idx, h.ip_block_batch_idx, h.blocked_ip AS ip_address, h.block_request_id, CONCAT('IP:', h.blocked_ip) AS block_target_key, COALESCE(h.rule_action, 'BLOCK') AS rule_action, COALESCE(h.control_mode, 'MANUAL') AS control_mode, COALESCE(h.ip_match_type, 'SINGLE_IP') AS match_type, h.cidr_notation, h.range_start_ip, h.range_end_ip, NULL AS country_code, NULL AS asn, COALESCE(h.block_scope, 'USER_ACTION') AS source_scope, 'MANUAL' AS block_category, h.user_idx, h.block_type, h.blocked_by_user_idx, h.reason, NULL AS risk_score, 0 AS is_auto_block, NULL AS auto_block_source, NULL AS detail_message, h.source_action_type, h.source_action_group_id, h.source_user_idx, h.source_ip_address, 1 AS priority, h.is_active, CASE WHEN h.after_effective_active IS NULL THEN h.is_active ELSE h.after_effective_active END AS is_effective_active, COALESCE(h.after_effective_status, 'EFFECTIVE') AS effective_status, h.blocked_at, h.expires_at, h.released_at, h.released_by_user_idx, h.list_synced_at AS last_synced_at, h.updated_at FROM USER_BLOCK_HISTORY h WHERE h.blocked_ip = #{ipAddress} AND h.rule_action = 'BLOCK' AND h.is_active = 1 AND (h.expires_at IS NULL OR h.expires_at > NOW()) ORDER BY h.blocked_at DESC, h.block_idx DESC LIMIT 1
mapper.update: UPDATE IP_BLOCKLIST SET is_active = FALSE, is_effective_active = FALSE, effective_status = 'RULE_INACTIVE', effective_status_reason = '현재 규칙이 비활성화되었습니다.', effective_synced_at = NOW(), effective_synced_by_source = 'SYSTEM', released_at = NOW(), released_by_user_idx = #{releasedByUserIdx}, last_synced_at = NOW(), updated_at = NOW() WHERE user_idx = #{userIdx} AND is_active = TRUE

UPDATE IP_BLOCKLIST SET is_active = FALSE, is_effective_active = FALSE, effective_status = 'RULE_INACTIVE', effective_status_reason = '현재 규칙이 비활성화되었습니다.', effective_synced_at = NOW(), effective_synced_by_source = 'SYSTEM', released_at = NOW(), released_by_user_idx = #{releasedByUserIdx}, last_synced_at = NOW(), updated_at = NOW() WHERE block_target_key = #{blockTargetKey}

UPDATE IP_BLOCKLIST SET is_active = FALSE, is_effective_active = FALSE, effective_status = 'RULE_INACTIVE', effective_status_reason = 'USER_ACTION 동기화 과정에서 현재 규칙을 비활성화했습니다.', effective_synced_at = NOW(), effective_synced_by_source = 'SYSTEM', released_at = NOW(), released_by_user_idx = #{releasedByUserIdx}, last_synced_at = NOW(), updated_at = NOW() WHERE block_target_key = #{blockTargetKey} AND source_scope = 'USER_ACTION' AND rule_action = 'BLOCK'
